frac.numerator.description: The top part of a fraction. The quantity being divided.

refinements.containsVariable: The numerator contains a variable, so it determines the zeros of the function (f(x)=0).
refinements.constantOnly: The numerator is a constant, so this fraction scales by a fixed ratio.

frac.denominator.description: The bottom part of a fraction. The quantity you divide by. If it becomes 0, the expression is undefined.

refinements.containsVariable: The denominator contains a variable, so the expression may be undefined at certain values (asymptotes).
refinements.constantOnly: The denominator is a constant, so it applies a fixed ratio to the whole expression.

power.base.description: The quantity that gets multiplied by itself in a power.

refinements.isEulerE: An exponential function with the natural constant e as its base. It models growth and decay.
refinements.isVariable: A power of a variable. The larger the exponent, the faster it grows.

power.exponent.description: How many times the base is multiplied by itself.

refinements.isTwo: Squared — the result is always 0 or greater.
refinements.isHalf: Square root — the positive square root of the base.
refinements.containsVariable: The exponent contains a variable, so it models exponential growth or decay.

sqrt.content.description: The quantity whose root is taken. Over the real numbers it cannot be negative.

sqrt.index.description: The n in an nth root. When omitted it is 2 (square root).

subscript.base.description: The object the subscript is attached to.

subscript.subscript.description: A number that picks out a particular element or component.

scripts.leftSuperscript.description: A number placed at the upper left of a symbol. It identifies the object, like the mass number of an isotope.

scripts.leftSubscript.description: A number placed at the lower left of a symbol. It identifies the object, like the atomic number of an element.

sum.lower.description: The index value where the summation starts.

sum.upper.description: The index value where the summation ends.

refinements.isInfinity: An infinite series summed to infinity. Whether it converges is the key question.

sum.body.description: The quantity added at each step. Its value depends on the index.

product.lower.description: The index value where the product starts.

product.upper.description: The index value where the product ends.

product.body.description: The quantity multiplied at each step.

integral.lower.description: The starting point of the interval of integration.

integral.upper.description: The ending point of the interval of integration.

refinements.isInfinity: The integral runs to positive infinity. You have to check whether it converges.

integral.integrand.description: The function being integrated. You are finding the area under its curve.

limit.approach.description: The target value the variable gets arbitrarily close to.

limit.body.description: You look at what value this expression converges to as the variable approaches its target.

paren.content.description: An expression enclosed in parentheses and treated as a single unit.

chem.content.description: Chemical notation representing substances and reactions.

abs.content.description: The magnitude with the sign ignored. The result is always 0 or greater.

func.argument.description: The value fed into the function.

matrix.element.description: A single element of the matrix.

cases.element.description: The function value when a particular condition holds.

overline.content.description: An overline denotes a mean, a complex conjugate, or a closure in topology.

cancel.content.description: The part that is reduced away or cancels out.

overset.base.description: The symbol the annotation is attached to.

overset.annotation.description: Extra explanation placed above or below a symbol.

xarrow.above.description: It states the conditions of a reaction or transformation.

xarrow.below.description: It states additional conditions of a reaction or transformation.
